Al cerrar la tapa de una notebook, Windo.english: When you close a laptop's lid, Windows does whatever its power settings say (almost always, sleep) and Trading Hub can't prevent it. To keep it working that way: Power Options → "Choose what closing the lid does" → "Do nothing", ideally only with the charger plugged in. With the lid closed the laptop doesn't ventilate as well: don't put it in a bag like that.
Al cerrar la tapa de una notebook, Windo.chinese: 合上笔记本电脑的盖子时，Windows 会按其电源设置执行操作（几乎总是进入睡眠），Trading Hub 无法阻止。要让它合盖后继续运行：电源选项 → “选择关闭笔记本计算机盖的功能” → “不采取任何操作”，最好只在接通充电器时这样设置。合盖时笔记本散热会变差：不要在这种状态下把它放进包里。

aliases.key: When you close a laptop's lid, Windows does whatever its power settings say (almost always, sleep) and Trading Hub can't prevent it. To keep it working that way: Power Options → "Choose what closing the lid does" → "Do nothing", ideally only with the charger plugged in. With the lid closed the laptop doesn't ventilate as well: don't put it in a bag like that.
aliases.es: Al cerrar la tapa de una notebook, Windows hace lo que diga su configuración de energía (casi siempre, suspenderse) y Trading Hub no lo puede evitar. Para que siga funcionando así: Opciones de energía → «Elegir el comportamiento del cierre de la tapa» → «No hacer nada», mejor solo con el cargador conectado. Con la tapa cerrada la notebook no ventila igual: no la guardes en un bolso así.
aliases.zh-CN: 合上笔记本电脑的盖子时，Windows 会按其电源设置执行操作（几乎总是进入睡眠），Trading Hub 无法阻止。要让它合盖后继续运行：电源选项 → “选择关闭笔记本计算机盖的功能” → “不采取任何操作”，最好只在接通充电器时这样设置。合盖时笔记本散热会变差：不要在这种状态下把它放进包里。

Al cerrar la tapa macOS duerme todo. Con.english: When you close the lid, macOS puts everything to sleep. With this on, when something is running Trading Hub asks for your administrator password once, and the Mac keeps working with the lid closed while Trading Hub is open. It's undone automatically when Trading Hub closes (even if it closes abruptly). With the lid closed the Mac doesn't ventilate as well: don't put it in a bag like that.
Al cerrar la tapa macOS duerme todo. Con.chinese: 合上盖子时，macOS 会让一切进入睡眠。开启此项后，有任务运行时 Trading Hub 会请求输入一次管理员密码，只要 Trading Hub 处于打开状态，Mac 合盖后也会继续运行。关闭 Trading Hub 时会自动撤销（即使是意外退出）。合盖时 Mac 散热会变差：不要在这种状态下把它放进包里。

correspondence.key: By default macOS sleeps when the lid closes. If enabled while work is running, Trading Hub asks once for administrator permission and keeps the Mac active with the lid closed. The setting reverts when the app exits. Closed-lid ventilation is limited: never store a running Mac in a bag.
correspondence.es: Al cerrar la tapa macOS duerme todo. Con esto activado, cuando haya algo corriendo Trading Hub te pide la contraseña de administrador una vez y la Mac sigue funcionando con la tapa cerrada mientras Trading Hub esté abierto. Se deshace solo al cerrar Trading Hub (aunque se cierre de golpe). Con la tapa cerrada la Mac no ventila igual: no la guardes en un bolso así.

Cada combinación se corre una sola vez s.english: Each combination runs only once over the whole history (repeated ticks are merged) and in each window the best plateau is chosen, not the best peak. At the end it measures overfitting: whether the best of one half of the history loses in the other (PBO), and several out-of-sample paths (CPCV).
Cada combinación se corre una sola vez s.chinese: 每个组合只在整段历史上运行一次（重复的 tick 会合并），每个窗口选取最佳的平台区，而不是最高的尖峰。最后会衡量过拟合：一半历史中的最佳组合在另一半是否亏损（PBO），以及多条样本外路径（CPCV）。

aliases.key: Each combination runs only once over the whole history (repeated ticks are merged) and in each window the best plateau is chosen, not the best peak. aliases.es: Cada combinación se corre una sola vez sobre toda la historia (los ticks repetidos se juntan) y en cada ventana se elige la mejor meseta, no el mejor pico. Al final mide el sobreajuste: si la mejor de una mitad de la historia pierde en la otra (PBO) y varios caminos fuera de muestra (CPCV).
aliases.zh-CN: 每个组合只在整段历史上运行一次（重复的 tick 会合并），每个窗口选取最佳的平台区，而不是最高的尖峰。最后会衡量过拟合：一半历史中的最佳组合在另一半是否亏损（PBO），以及多条样本外路径（CPCV）。

Cerrar la ventana no cierra Trading Hub:.english: Closing the window doesn't close Trading Hub: it stays at the bottom right, in the system tray (next to the clock; if you don't see it, click the little ^ arrow), with the live strategies working. Clicking its icon opens a panel with the strategies and positions in real time; right-clicking opens a menu. To quit completely: Alt+F4 or "Quit Trading Hub" in that panel.
Cerrar la ventana no cierra Trading Hub:.chinese: 关闭窗口不会退出 Trading Hub：它会留在右下角的系统托盘中（时钟旁边；如果看不到，点击小箭头 ^），实时策略继续工作。点击其图标会打开一个面板，实时显示策略和持仓；右键点击则打开菜单。要完全退出：按 Alt+F4，或在该面板中点击“退出 Trading Hub”。

aliases.zh-CN: Claude（Opus，超高推理强度）会查看每个策略的盈亏、连胜/连亏、相对其历史的回撤、波动率和相关性，并分配风险：在你设定的上限内调整每个策略的规模和限额。对于实盘账户，它总是只提出提议，由你批准。

Es un backtest nuevo con el filtro de co.english: This is a new backtest with the context filter, not a slice of the previous one: on each candle the strategy checks the context measured up to that moment and only opens a trade if it is one of the chosen ones (exits always go through), just like live. Careful: if you pick the conditions by looking at these same results, you are testing on the same data; to know whether it really holds up, validate it with walk-forward or on another period.
Es un backtest nuevo con el filtro de co.chinese: 这是一次带市场环境过滤的全新回测，而不是从上一次结果中截取：在每根K线上，策略会查看截至当时测得的市场环境，只有属于所选行情时才开仓（平仓始终放行），与实时运行一致。注意：如果你是看着这些结果来挑选行情的，那仍是在同一批数据上测试；要知道是否真的有效，请用滚动前推或在其他时间段验证。

aliases.key: This is a new backtest with the context filter, not a slice of the previous one: on each candle the strategy checks the context measured up to that moment and only opens a trade if it is one of the chosen ones (exits always go through), just like live. Careful: if you pick the conditions by looking at these same results, you are testing on the same data; to know whether it really holds up, validate it with walk-forward or on another period.
aliases.es: Es un backtest nuevo con el filtro de contexto, no un recorte del anterior: en cada vela la estrategia mira el contexto medido hasta ese momento y solo abre si es uno de los elegidos (las salidas siempre pasan), igual que en vivo. Ojo: si elegís las condiciones mirando estos mismos resultados, es sobre los mismos datos; para saber si vale de verdad, validalo con walk-forward o en otro período.
aliases.zh-CN: 这是一次带市场环境过滤的全新回测，而不是从上一次结果中截取：在每根K线上，策略会查看截至当时测得的市场环境，只有属于所选行情时才开仓（平仓始终放行），与实时运行一致。注意：如果你是看着这些结果来挑选行情的，那仍是在同一批数据上测试；要知道是否真的有效，请用滚动前推或在其他时间段验证。
